presented with the chief complains of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain abdomen since 1 :30pm yesterday\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFollowed by 2 episodes of vomitings\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe attained menarche at 15 yrs age and she got married to a daily laborer. She has given birth to 8 children ( 4 daughters , 4 sons).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E18 years back she got dyspneic on a cold winter night when she was rushed to a local hospital and was put on budecort and ashtalin as told by the attendant. Ever since then she has been experiencing dyspnea and cough during winters and has everytime been using levosalbutamol and budecort inhaler.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E15 years back she got admitted in a hospital with fever when she was told that she was diabetic and was put on oral medications which she has been using regularly since then.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe has been occasionally consuming alcohol around 90 ml of whiskey once a month. 4 days back she consumed 90ml of whiskey when all her family got together and also tells she ate home made chicken last night. She\u0026nbsp; presented to us\u0026nbsp; yesterday with the complains of pain abdomen since 1:30pm which is diffuse though it was more in her right hypochondriac which was aggravated on food consumption, which releaved on leaning forward. After 1 hour of onset of her pain abdomen she 2 episodes of vomitings which were non projectile, non bilious and non blood tinged, containing food content.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe gives no history of fever, loose stools, cough,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of intake of outside or canned food\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe gives no complains of myalgias, sore throat, fever or neck pain, fatigue, body aches.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe is diabetic since 15 yrs and obese,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe had no pallor, lymphadenopathy, cyanosis, clubbing, icterus\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E15 yr old woman, in her intermediate second year, whose father is a farmer and mother is a daily laborer and has 2 elder siblings (elder sister who is in B tech first yr and twin brother passed his inter 1st yr) residing at Duppali, Nalgonda district presented to the opd with the chief complains of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneralised weakness since 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELoss of appetite since 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHeadache since 1 month\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EYellowish discoloration of sclera and\u0026nbsp; urine since 1 week\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVomitings since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe attained menarche 6 months back since then she has been having regular cycles, 2 pads per day, 5\/30, she skipped her cycle last month otherwise her cycles have been regular.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe was apparently alright 4 years back when she started feeling weak, found it difficult to participate in sports, her parents even observed she was getting pale then she was taken\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eto a local hospital where she was told that\u0026nbsp; she had anemia and was given medications. She was not given any blood transfusions.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe continued with normal daily activity and gave no complains of weakness until 1 month back.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 month she again started experiencing generalized weakness, loss of appetite and diffuse throbbing type of headache.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1 week back her parents observed that her eyes were yellow in color for which she took herbal medications for 1 week aft\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; Here Iam presenting\u0026nbsp; a case of I have followed\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003ECASE:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA Female patient who is daily labourer in occupation of age 55 years\u0026nbsp; walked in to casualty with the chief complaints of the distension of the abdomen since last 10 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPresent illness :She is apparently asymptomatic 2 years back, when she first developed pain in abdomen which was dull aching type, which was localized to the epigastrium and left hypochondrium pain was insidious in onset and it got aggravated with food intake pain used get relieved through self induced vomiting. She also stated that she is having early satiety and started lossing her weight. Which she first observed that her clothes becoming loose ( thickness in the lips and temporal wasting). She also stated that she is progressively becoming fatigued such that she has to finally stop going to her work .she also complained that once she had a involuntary vomiting which\u0026nbsp; was frank blood ( hematemesis) .It was only one episode which was 50 ml. No h\/o of bilious vomiting,heart burn, nocturnal cough, dyspepsia, Malena, hematochezia, purpura, echymosis, loose stools, or constipation. She also complained that she was having night sweats which were drenching and made her bath. She is having low grade fever, chills and rigors. She denies joint pain, back pain, dysuria, hematuria, cough, expectorations, wheeze (or) frequent URTIS.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPast history :She is a.
